tenderSchedule.title: Vehicle Hiring
tenderSchedule.description: Hiring of Vehicle - A/c with Drivers on Month and Daily Basis

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Board Room, KSBCL Head office, 4th Floor TTMC Shanthinagara

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience Certificate in the prescribed Form B establishing that the bidder has experience for at least one year in supplying of transport services for supplying a minimum of 8 drivers to offices of State Government/ PSUs of Karnataka.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Form B of the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must be a legally registered Company (Private/Public Limited), Limited Liability Partnership (LLP), Partnership Firm, or Sole Proprietorship agency operating in India under the relevant Indian laws.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- A valid Certificate of Incorporation, Registration Certificate, or Partnership Deed Udyam MSME Registration Certificate must be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Ownership/agreement/lease for cars for the contract period. (At least 8 cars)
Audited financial statements of the previous 3 years, with an annual turnover of not less than Rs. 150 lakhs in the previous three financial years along with certificate of authorized CA.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Valid drivers licenses of at least 08 drivers.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Small Scale Industries Certificate MSME Udyam certificate
